name: iPad Till Category Layout Reliability
notes: Frontend-only iPad Till layout fix. Category wrapper flex items no longer shrink inside the horizontally scrolling category strip, preventing minimum-width category buttons from overflowing into neighbouring wrappers and visually overlapping. Long category labels wrap inside a bounded button width. Existing compatible Apps Script backends 3.13.16, 3.13.17 and 3.13.18 remain supported; included Code.gs remains 3.13.18 and is unchanged. Database remains 1.0.6.
